item.title: New US charge d’affaires arrives in Venezuela to reopen diplomatic mission after 7 years
item.description: CARACAS (AP) — U.S. Ambassador Laura Dogu arrived in Caracas on Saturday to reopen the American diplomatic mission in Venezuela after seven years of severed ties. item.title: Chicago orders police to document potentially illegal federal immigration tactics
item.description: Mayor Brandon Johnson of Chicago ordered city police Saturday to begin formally documenting instances of aggressive and potentially illegal federal immigration enforcement actions, looking to build cases for prosecution against the most egregious actions.

item.title: Indivisible Sonoma County launches weekly protest at Santa Rosa Target over ICE
item.description: Approximately 250 demonstrators attended the protest organized by Indivisible Sonoma County on Saturday, calling on the corporation to bar federal immigration enforcement agents from entering its stores without a judicial warrant.

item.title: Camden scores 26 points, Dut an unlikely hero in Cal’s 86-85 win over Miami
item.description: Little-used Dut had a critical block late and followed that with his only basket of the game to send Cal to a victory in Miami.

item.title: Steph Curry injury update: Warriors provide new info on sore knee
item.description: Steph Curry left Friday's game against the Pistons in the third quarter, did not return.

item.title: Piner halts girls basketball game with Healdsburg after on-court scuffle, ejections
item.description: The Prospectors coach elected to forfeit Friday night's game with just minutes left, saying he was concerned for the safety of his players after the contest became physical and heated.

item.title: SF Giants agree with three-time batting champ Luis Arraez on one-year deal: report
item.description: Arraez will probably slot in as the starting second baseman, which would turn infielder Casey Schmitt into a super utility player.
